page.layout: One printed page, one column of text. Top: title block and dedication set as headings, full width. Below: the body text in one column, with a decorative initial at its start. Foot: signature "A" at left and catchword "Klar" at right. Page number at top right.

main_text.l: Herrn/ Herrn George/ Herzogen zu Sachsen/
vnd Herr / recht bey sich bedencken vnnd
schen Gelegenheit / vnnd den Zustand menschli-
ches Lebens / so wird ers darfür achten / daß des
faßt zu sehr zubeweinen noch zu beklagen sey / sin-
temal ihme auff dieser Welt vnnd Erden so
grosse Glückseligkeit begegnet / als wenig Men-
schen pflegt zu widerfahren. Dann so wir die eus-
serliche ding rechnen wöllen / so war er seines her-
kommens halber ein Geschlechter / zu Nürmberg
schen Stätten die fürnembste am Beruff vnnd Klar

page.notes: The decorative initial M of "Mann" is a large woodcut letter, transcribed as one word. The small mark "I" above the title is a printer's ornament or signature-style mark, not transcribed. The numeral at top right reads "113" in a worn form; it is the folio number as printed. The page is set in roman and black letter, with the title in black letter; the text here is copied as printed in roman type. The word "Klar" at the foot is the catchword and is not repeated in the text.
